fixture_notice: Synthetic local fixture for offline evaluation. Riverside Tenants Council, participants, and building details are fictional.
community: A fictional tenants council with 12 expected participants
workshop_goal: Co-design a one-page building outage contact and accessibility card that residents can test and revise.
constraints: The session is exactly 45 minutes and has one facilitator plus one note-taker.
Participants include two people with limited English, one person who cannot stand for long, and residents who work night shifts.
Do not ask participants to disclose medical diagnoses or personal safety situations in the group.
A resident who cannot attend should have a way to comment later.

claims: Residents previously found a long phone tree confusing; a short primary/backup contact card is preferred as a design hypothesis.

success_signals: participants can explain the card's next action
participants can identify an accessibility route
dissent and unanswered questions are recorded
